fullContentHtml:
IB MTS Final Result 2026 – Full Details

MHA Intelligence Bureau IB has released the Final Result for the post of Multi Tasking Staff on the official website of IB. This recruitment was released for 362 posts. Applications for the Intelligence Bureau (IB) MTS Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 22 November 2025, to 14 December 2025. The tier-II examination is going to conducted on 12 July 2026. Candidates who had appeared in tier-I examination can download their Intelligence Bureau (IB) MTS Final Result 2026 from the link provided below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 22 November 2025
  • Last Date : 14 December 2025
  • Online Fee Payment Last Date : 14 December 2025
  • Exam Date : 27 January 2026
  • Exam City : 08 January 2026
  • Admit Card : 24 January 2026
  • Answer Key : 29 January 2026
  • Result Tier-I : 13 April 2026
  • Tier-II Exam Date : 12 July 2026
  • Tier-II Admit Card : 11 July 2026
  • Final Result : 05 October 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 650/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 550/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is IB MTS Final Result 2026?

IB MTS Final Result 2026 is the official result announcement. Candidates can check their scorecard and merit status via the direct link above.
